description: This file contains unit tests for the lifecycle management of components in an Orleans-based application, including tests for full lifecycle, failure scenarios on start and stop, and multi-stage observers.

classes.name: LifecycleTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for lifecycle behaviors, including full lifecycle, failure scenarios, and multi-stage participation.

classes.name: TestLifecycleSubject
classes.description: A test implementation of LifecycleSubject used for testing lifecycle behaviors.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Implements ILifecycleObserver to simulate component behavior during lifecycle events, with options to fail on start or stop.

classes.name: MultiStageObserver
classes.description: Implements ILifecycleParticipant to participate in multiple lifecycle stages and track their invocation.

classes.name: TestStages
classes.description: Enumeration of lifecycle stages used in tests.

methods.name: FullLifecycleTest
methods.description: Tests the complete lifecycle of observers, ensuring all start and stop correctly without failures.

methods.name: FailOnStartOnEachStageLifecycleTest
methods.description: Tests lifecycle behavior when observers fail on start at each stage.

methods.name: FailOnStopOnEachStageLifecycleTest
methods.description: Tests lifecycle behavior when observers fail on stop at each stage.

methods.name: MultiStageObserverLifecycleTest
methods.description: Verifies that a multi-stage observer participates correctly in all lifecycle stages.

methods.name: RunLifecycle
methods.description: Helper method to set up and run lifecycle tests with specified failure conditions.
